headword: {総支給額|そうしきゅうがく}
gloss: gross pay; total amount paid before deductions

definitions.gloss: gross pay; total payment before deductions
definitions.explanation: The full amount of a salary or bonus before tax and insurance are taken out. It appears at the top of a Japanese pay slip, with {手取|てど}り (take-home pay) shown at the bottom.

examples.japanese: {総支給額|そうしきゅうがく}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: I check the gross pay amount.

examples.japanese: {総支給額|そうしきゅうがく}から{税金|ぜいきん}が{引|ひ}かれる。
examples.english: Taxes are deducted from the gross pay.

examples.japanese: {総支給額|そうしきゅうがく}は{増|ふ}えたのに、{保険料|ほけんりょう}が{上|あ}がったので{手取|てど}りはほとんど{変|か}わらなかった。
examples.english: My gross pay went up, but insurance premiums rose, so my take-home pay barely changed.

notes:
{総|そう} (total) + {支給|しきゅう} (payment, provision) + {額|がく} (amount). A pay-slip term rather than a conversational one.

PAY SLIP VOCABULARY:
- {総支給額|そうしきゅうがく}: gross pay
- {控除|こうじょ}: deductions (tax, pension, insurance)
- {差引支給額|さしひきしきゅうがく}: net pay (the line labelled on the slip)
- {手取|てど}り: take-home pay (the everyday spoken word)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総支給額|そうしきゅうがく}が{増|ふ}える: gross pay increases
- {総支給額|そうしきゅうがく}から{引|ひ}かれる: to be deducted from gross pay

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手取|てど}り: take-home pay — what actually reaches your account; the usual word in conversation
- {年収|ねんしゅう}: annual income — normally quoted as a gross yearly figure
